claim: a caller who binds nothing gets byte-identical results on all 65 outputs across 4 lanes and 3 phases (prefill, decode, decode-fed-from-decode). This is a transparency result, not a saving: the naive caller reads every output, so he pays the same transfer through a different door (see byte_doors).
